direct_full_document_review: This register entry has a reported complete substantive-document reading in the October 9 supplementary passes.
direct_targeted_review: Relevant sections were read; the complete contribution was not certified.
document_relationship_check: Overlap/incorporation checked without full review of the composite document.
index_with_targeted_linked_response_revi: The register entry is an index; a linked substantive response received targeted review.
lead_awaiting_content_recovery: No direct substantive review or resolving link recorded; includes metadata-only leads. It is not a finding that every underlying document is irretrievably unavailable.
link_to_existing_included_or_inspected_r: A related source is already included/inspected in the frozen archive, at heterogeneous depths; not proof that this entry is a duplicate or fully read.
link_to_existing_partial_review: Related source has partial recorded coverage.
link_to_new_supplemental_review: Linked source received a supplementary review; inspect that source’s scope.
metadata_or_index_only_inspection: Index/landing page inspected; no substantive contribution represented.
other_unresolved_linked_record: A source relation exists but does not resolve substantive coverage.
precedence: A later direct review replaces the earlier local-pending status; otherwise retain the first-pass direct or link/lead status. Related links are separate from direct review and do not inherit it.
retrieval_limit: 26 selected regulations.gov attachment attempts returned HTTP 403 in the first supplement pass. This is not 26 unique irrecoverable documents or a finding about all 891 residual leads.
